questions.text: Which build tool provides a significantly faster development server by using native ES modules?
questions.context: Note: Consider tools introduced after Webpack that leverage the browser's native import support.
questions.explanation: Vite uses native ES modules in the browser during development, bypassing the need to bundle the entire app upfront. This makes its dev server near-instant to start regardless of project size.

questions.text: React hooks can be called conditionally inside standard if-statements.
questions.explanation: React's Rules of Hooks strictly prohibit calling hooks inside conditions, loops, or nested functions. Hooks must always be called at the top level of a component so React can preserve their order between renders.

questions.text: The open-source Firebase alternative that uses a PostgreSQL database is called ___.
questions.context: Hint: It offers authentication, a real-time database, and storage — all self-hostable.
questions.explanation: Supabase is built on top of PostgreSQL and provides a Firebase-like developer experience with a REST and real-time API, row-level security, auth, and file storage — all open source.

questions.text: Drag and Drop: Categorize these frameworks/libraries based on their primary use.
questions.explanation: React handles UI rendering, Next.js adds routing and SSR on top of React, Supabase provides backend services (database, auth, storage), and Vite is the build/bundling tool that ties it all together during development.
